claim.purpose: Repair generation-aware compact-card authority and preparation-safe typed SIP, STP, and SRP semantics

initial.title: [v0.91.8][WP-14][csdlc-v2] Make typed card generation registry-aware and preparation-safe
initial.goal: Unblock typed C-SDLC v2 preparation by making native compact generation registry-aware and lossless.
initial.required_outcome: Native compact v2 1.0.0 and legacy/import 1.0.3 remain distinct while bootstrap, migration, preparation edits, and review assignment preserve explicit constraints, criteria, and review scope.
declared_scope: bootstrap, migration, semantic edit, review assignment, and focused tests
authority_boundary: typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle is authoritative
ADL owner binaries provide GitHub truth
legacy/import 1.0.3 and native compact v2 1.0.0 are distinct families
initial.task_boundary: Implement only the grouped C-SDLC v2 authority repair required by issue #5597.
deliverables: preparation-safe SIP, STP, and SRP operations
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Registry distinguishes legacy/import 1.0.3 from native compact v2 1.0.0 without false provenance
AC-2: Initialization validates registry and compact shape before writing and fails closed on incompatible truth
AC-3: Existing native 1.0.0 records remain readable and legacy 1.0.3 import remains separate
AC-4: Bootstrap and migration preserve explicit SIP operator constraints and SRP review scope including explicit none
AC-5: Typed SIP operator-constraint replacement is preparation-safe in initialized, ready, and bound phases
AC-6: Typed STP acceptance replacement atomically revalidates SPP step and VPP proof-role coverage
AC-7: Bound SRP replanning is preparation-safe and review assignment synchronizes authoritative scope immediately
AC-8: Focused Gate 2, identity, review, migration, and Gate 9 parity tests plus strict lint and owner validation pass
AC-9: Exact-revision review has no unresolved actionable finding and blocked consumer packets can use typed repair
initial.plan_summary: Add compact native registry authority, thread explicit semantics through input and migration, add phase-safe typed operations with atomic coverage checks, synchronize review scope, and prove the exact compatibility boundary.

steps.action: Add generation-aware registry and crate-owned compact shape validation
Preserve constraints and review scope through bootstrap and migration
Implement preparation-safe SIP, STP, and bound SRP semantic operations with atomic coverage validation
Run focused proof, strict lint, owner validation, exact-revision review, publication, and closeout

invariants: no silent criteria or scope loss
risks: registry drift could stamp incompatible shapes
preparation edits could bypass coverage invariants
review assignment could leave stale SRP truth
stop_conditions: required work expands beyond the grouped repair

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove registry, bootstrap, identity, migration, editing, and review semantics
Prove formatting and strict all-target lint
Prove the C-SDLC owner validation lane

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on incompatible registry truth, data loss, incomplete acceptance coverage, stale review, lifecycle ambiguity, or scope expansion.
review_prompts: Are template families distinct and provenance truthful?
Can any typed edit silently drop acceptance coverage?
Are bootstrap, migration, and review scope lossless?
Do focused tests prove existing 1.0.0 compatibility and legacy 1.0.3 separation?
operator_constraints: Use typed v2 lifecycle and owner binaries only
Never use raw gh or AWS
initial.review_scope: Review the exact substantive revision for registry authority, compatibility, lossless typed semantics, phase authorization, atomic coverage validation, and migration safety.
